searchText: How is this addressing a regression? What regressed? MAX_REFUND_QUOTIENT from 2 to 5 resulted in transient storage being unusable for more than 1 or 2 variables it was explicitly considered, but i think not with the refund cap > For example, zero -> nonzero -> zero storage set patterns continue to cost only ~100 gas btw I think there is an alternative long-term way to get the same effect Which is that https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/verkle_write_gas_extension could be modified to add a refund when a value is reset to its original value
